period_note: Half-Yearly filing (H1, cumulative Jan 1 - Jun 30 2013), stored in the Q2 slot per project convention. Consolidated basis (document explicitly titled 'Consolidated Balance Sheet (Un-Audited)' / 'Consolidated Profit and Loss Account (Un-Audited)'). Source: MTB's own contemporaneous H1-2013 unaudited interim financial statement, downloaded from mutualtrustbank.com/regulatory-disclosure/financial-statements/ -- a SCANNED IMAGE PDF (pdftotext extracted 0 lines). Recovered by directly reading the rasterized page image (pdftoppm 300dpi) rather than via tesseract OCR: tesseract's default single-block mode badly interleaves this template's 3-column layout (Balance Sheet | P&L | Notes), merging unrelated rows onto the same OCR line; a direct visual read of the image avoids this and was cross-validated arithmetically instead. TRAP FOUND AND AVOIDED: the P&L income section prints an unlabelled boxed subtotal (Income from Investments + Commission + Other Operating Income) directly above the true bold 'Total Operating Income' row (which additionally includes Net Interest Income) -- confirmed by zooming into the row labels directly; verified this file's own Total Operating Income (1,965,857,618) = Net Interest Income (293,701,682) + the subtotal (1,672,155,935). VALIDATION: Total Liabilities + Total Shareholders' Equity + Minority Interest (92,778,734,884+4,858,367,108+78,593=97,637,180,585) reproduces Total Property and Asset (97,637,180,586) to within BDT 1 (rounding). P&L chain exact: Profit Before Provision(751,213,892) - Total Provision(441,078,565) = 310,135,327 = Profit Before Tax; - Tax(273,905,187) = 36,230,140 = Net Profit After Tax, both as printed. Cross-checked this document's own Dec-31-2012 comparative column against the already-stored 2012_Q4.json (in BDT million): total_assets 93,162 vs stored 93162 (exact), total_liabilities 88,328 vs stored 88328 (exact), total_equity 4,834 vs stored 4834 (exact), total_deposits 75,140 vs stored 75140 (exact), gross_loans 56,511 vs stored 56511 (exact), investments_securities 23,251 vs stored 23251 (exact), contingent_liabilities 17,677 vs stored 17676 (immaterial 1m rounding) -- full agreement.
